name: tchoukaillon
description: Tchoukaillon (one-row mancala solitaire) in the browser with an exact solver, the winning board for any number of stones, the n²/π law measured to n = 10^8, and every checkable claim of Broline–Loeb (1995) and Jones–Taalman–Tongen (2013) recomputed. TypeScript, no runtime deps.
